services.desc: Spanning 22 acres, Fox Run is the perfect blend of postcard views and function. Fox Run offers: State of the art footing in the 60'x160' indoor arena with a precise mix of sand and string rubber as well as a unique product to eliminate dust. Massive mirrors allow you to see yourself ride. Recently expanded outdoor arena large enough to accommodate a full-sized dressage ring and a separate jumping area. Daily turnout, weather permitting, in a variety of paddocks and pastures, including two all-season sand paddocks, ideal in wet or sloppy

blurb: Guests train and take lessons in dressage with USDF gold medalist Carol Heckman, either boarding their own horse at the facility or trailering in. The facility includes state-of-the-art arenas, a round pen, and access to trails. Monthly clinics with top dressage professionals are offered, and barn space is available for lease to trainers.
extraNote: Horse boarding space is limited; contact to inquire · Discounts given for lesson packages of at least one lesson per week · Fox Run Equestrian facility at 1307 Porterville Road, East Aurora, NY 14052
